stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The city replaced some old benches with new ones that had metal bars between seats.”?
options: A student group studied the street for a science project.

A student group used the data to make a map of bus stops without shade.

本文沒有陳述「A student group visited the roof for a science report.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A student group used the data to make a map of bus stops without shade.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A student group questioned the decision.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
